reviews.author: Hira Javed
reviews.text: Went early on a Saturday for the fish and vegetable stalls. Everything was fresh, the vendors were fair with prices and the lanes were far less crowded before 9 AM.

reviews.author: Bilal Sheikh
reviews.text: Great variety under one roof — spices, dry fruit, meat and vegetables. It gets very crowded after 11 AM, so go early and keep your bag close.

reviews.author: Saad Ahmed
reviews.text: The dry fruit and spice stalls here are the best in Saddar. Prices are negotiable on bulk purchases and the vendors were honest about weights.

reviews.author: Alishba Khan
reviews.text: Produce quality is consistently good here. Parking is the only real problem — we had to park two streets away on a Friday afternoon.

reviews.author: Hamza Iqbal
reviews.text: Good market overall, but the meat section smelled stale on my last visit and the floor was wet. The vegetables were perfectly fine though.

reviews.author: Nida Farhan
reviews.text: Bought a full week of vegetables and fruit for less than what the supermarket charges. The coriander and mint stayed fresh for four days.

reviews.author: Fatima Khan
reviews.text: A historic market that is genuinely worth the trip. Come on a weekday morning, wear shoes you don't mind getting dusty and carry small notes.

reviews.author: Usman Malik
reviews.text: Went on a Sunday and it was shoulder to shoulder with a long wait at every popular stall. Prices were noticeably higher than the outer market too.

reviews.author: Imran Qureshi
reviews.text: Wholesale rates here are hard to beat if you buy by the crate. Reached at 6 AM and got the first pick of the tomatoes and onions.

reviews.author: Sana Riaz
reviews.text: Perfect for bulk shopping before a family event. Got a whole carton of mangoes at nearly half the retail price and the vendor helped load the car.

reviews.author: Ahmed Raza
reviews.text: Quality is good if you come early. By 10 AM the best stock is gone and the lanes get tight with hand carts, so plan your trip accordingly.

reviews.author: Zainab Ali
reviews.text: Great prices on rice, flour and pulses. Bring exact change and confirm the weight of every sack before you pay.

reviews.author: Kashif Mehmood
reviews.text: Cheap but chaotic. Some stalls quote one price and change it once you show interest, so compare a few before buying anything.

reviews.author: Rabia Nasir
reviews.text: The dry fruit and dates here are far cheaper than any supermarket. Stocked up for the whole month and everything was fresh and well packed.

reviews.author: Danish Ali
reviews.text: A proper wholesale market if you know what you are doing. Parking on the side street was manageable at 7 AM and the traders were helpful.

reviews.author: Ayesha Siddiqui
reviews.text: A weekend farmers market with genuinely fresh produce. The organic greens and strawberries were picked the same morning.

reviews.author: Farhan Butt
reviews.text: Small but beautifully curated. Loved the fresh cheese and honey stalls, and every vendor let us taste before buying.

reviews.author: Mehwish Tariq
reviews.text: A lovely Saturday morning outing for the family. Slightly premium prices, but the quality of the vegetables justifies every rupee.

reviews.author: Omar Sheikh
reviews.text: The best place in DHA for seasonal fruit. Picked up sweet Sindhri mangoes at a fair price and the grower explained how to ripen them at home.

reviews.author: Sarah Malik
reviews.text: Very clean and family friendly with wide walkways. It only runs on weekends, so weekday shopping here is not possible.

reviews.author: Hammad Raza
reviews.text: Friendly growers, honest weights and absolutely no haggling. I now do my weekly vegetables here instead of the supermarket.

reviews.author: Nadia Hussain
reviews.text: A well stocked neighbourhood market. Vegetables, fruit and a bakery all in one stretch, within a short walk of the main road.

reviews.author: Talha Ansari
reviews.text: Good quality produce and clean lanes. Prices run a little higher than the sabzi mandi, but the convenience is worth it on weekdays.

reviews.author: Areeba Yousuf
reviews.text: Friendly vendors who remember their regulars. The spinach and peas were excellent this week and the fruit stall was well stocked.

reviews.author: Shoaib Anwar
reviews.text: Decent market for daily shopping, but the parking situation on Khayaban-e-Bukhari is rough in the evenings and the queues get long.

reviews.author: Marium Nadeem
reviews.text: A nice mix of grocery, meat and fruit stalls. The meat section was clean and the butcher cut everything exactly to order.

reviews.author: Hamza Jamil
reviews.text: Sea-facing stalls make this a pleasant evening walk. The fresh fish counter is the highlight, got pomfret straight off the ice.

reviews.author: Erum Aslam
reviews.text: Great fresh fish and prawns at fair rates. Ask for the catch of the day and the vendors will clean and pack it for you.

reviews.author: Ahsan Kapadia
reviews.text: A good stop after a walk at Sea View. Slightly pricier than Malir, but the seafood quality and cleanliness are much better.

reviews.author: Laila Rehman
reviews.text: Very clean for a seafood market and the vendors were polite. Bought crabs and they packed them properly with ice for the drive home.

reviews.author: Bilal Chaudhry
reviews.text: Nice location and great fish, but the vegetable choice is limited. Mostly seafood and snack stalls, so I still buy produce elsewhere.

reviews.author: Zohaib Niazi
reviews.text: An evening market by the water with excellent grilled seafood and fresh fruit carts. Great value for a family outing on the weekend.

reviews.author: Mahnoor Iqbal
reviews.text: Fresh vegetables and fruit at reasonable rates. Best to go after sunset once every stall is open and the fish is iced down for the night.

reviews.author: Adeel Shah
reviews.text: The fish here is as fresh as it gets and the vendors clean it for free. Also loved the seasonal fruit stalls at the entrance.

reviews.author: Kiran Zia
reviews.text: Good selection and friendly sellers. It gets busy on weekend nights and finding a table nearby can take a while.

reviews.author: Junaid Malik
reviews.text: A great mix of produce and street food. Bought fresh guavas and bananas that were perfectly ripe and sweet.

reviews.author: Sumaira Baig
reviews.text: The cheapest good quality vegetables in Gulshan. Early morning stock is the freshest and the prices drop further close to closing time.

reviews.author: Yasir Hamid
reviews.text: Great for bulk vegetables at wholesale rates. The lanes are narrow and muddy after rain, so wear shoes you can wash.

reviews.author: Nabeel Anwar
reviews.text: Prices are low but the quality varies from stall to stall. Check the bottom of the crate before buying potatoes or onions in bulk.

reviews.author: Farzana Hakim
reviews.text: Bought a week of vegetables for a family of six at a very reasonable price. Vendors happily helped carry the bags to the car.

reviews.author: Rehan Siddiqui
reviews.text: A solid vegetable market. Parking is tricky at peak hours and the crowd is heaviest between 8 and 10 in the morning.

reviews.author: Sidra Rauf
reviews.text: A clean and well organised market with everything from vegetables to household goods. I finish my weekly shopping in a single trip.

reviews.author: Kamran Aziz
reviews.text: Good quality fruit at fair prices. The fruit stalls at the entrance carry the best seasonal stock, especially the mangoes.

reviews.author: Anum Faisal
reviews.text: A nice neighbourhood market. The staff at the bakery and the produce stalls are always polite and quick with the weighing.

reviews.author: Waqas Ahmed
reviews.text: Average quality on my last visit. The tomatoes were underripe and the queue at the checkout was long on a Sunday evening.

reviews.author: Hina Sattar
reviews.text: Very convenient and always well stocked. Fresh milk and eggs are available without any rush if you shop in the morning.

reviews.author: Danish Kamal
reviews.text: A weekend farmers market with proper farm-fresh vegetables. The spinach, carrots and salad leaves were noticeably fresher than the regular sabzi market.

reviews.author: Rabia Shafiq
reviews.text: Genuine growers selling directly, so you can ask exactly when something was harvested. Prices are fair for this kind of quality.

reviews.author: Salman Yousaf
reviews.text: Limited stalls but everything is good quality. I reached at 9 AM and some greens were already sold out, so it pays to go early.

reviews.author: Alina Tariq
reviews.text: A lovely atmosphere with local honey and homemade pickle stalls as well. It only runs on Saturday and Sunday mornings.

reviews.author: Imad ul Haq
reviews.text: Excellent seasonal fruit. Got peaches and plums at a great price and the vendors were friendly and honest with the weights.

reviews.author: Faiza Arooj
reviews.text: A big covered market with everything from fresh produce to clothing. The vegetable section stays well stocked throughout the day.

reviews.author: Arsalan Khan
reviews.text: Good variety and reasonable prices under one roof. It gets very crowded on Sunday evenings, so plan your visit around that.

reviews.author: Nimra Aslam
reviews.text: The meat and poultry counters are clean and the staff weigh everything in front of you. Fruit stalls are fresh in the morning.

reviews.author: Tauqeer Abbas
reviews.text: Fine for everyday shopping, but the produce quality is inconsistent and the alleys get very tight when the market is busy.

reviews.author: Shazia Noor
reviews.text: Very convenient for the whole family, with groceries, fruit and household items in one place at fair prices.

reviews.author: Ghulam Abbas
reviews.text: Arrived at 5:30 AM for the first trucks and the produce was straight off the farm. Wholesale prices without any middleman involved.

reviews.author: Mehak Rizvi
reviews.text: The cheapest fresh vegetables in the city if you are willing to go early. A full crate of bananas for a fraction of the retail price.

reviews.author: Salman Baig
reviews.text: Huge variety and honest wholesale rates. Be ready for early hours, a lot of dust and plenty of pushing in the narrow lanes.

reviews.author: Mehrun Nisa
reviews.text: Great prices but the market is rough and crowded. Not comfortable with children, and there are no proper washrooms on site.

reviews.author: Adeel Ahmed
reviews.text: The potatoes, onions and ginger here are excellent value in bulk. Vendors helped load everything straight into the van.

reviews.author: Noman Siddiqui
reviews.text: A solid local market with fresh vegetables and dairy. Better prices than the nearby supermarket for everyday groceries.

reviews.author: Bushra Kamran
reviews.text: The fruit stalls here are excellent value. The watermelons and mangoes this season were sweet and very reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Zubair Hashmi
reviews.text: Clean lanes and helpful vendors. The fish counter is small but the stock was fresh when I visited in the morning.

reviews.author: Sadaf Amin
reviews.text: A friendly neighbourhood market. Bought a week of vegetables and fruit for the family and everything stayed fresh.

reviews.author: Rizwan Butt
reviews.text: Quality is decent but a few stalls need better hygiene. Go early in the morning when the produce is freshest and prices are lower.
